technology_name: Eco-Friendly Blood Stain Removal: Bio-based Protease Enzyme
institution: KSCSTE- Malabar Botanical Garden & Institute for Plant Sciences (MBGIPS)
problem_solved: Difficulty in effectively removing protein-rich blood stains using conventional chemical detergents, which pose environmental concerns and risk damaging fabrics.
description: A biological stain-removal solution utilizing a novel protease enzyme extracted from the endophytic bacterium Bacillus altitudinis, isolated from the rhizosphere of the medicinal plant Lagenandra toxicaria. The enzyme targets blood stains by cleaving the peptide bonds in hemoglobin and associated proteins, converting them into water-soluble fragments easily washed away. It functions with high efficiency at ambient temperatures and achieves near-complete stain removal on cotton within 12 hours without causing fabric degradation.
applications:
• Formulation ingredient for eco-friendly household laundry detergents

• Specialty stain-removal agents for commercial hospital and clinical laundry systems

• Industrial scale enzyme production for bio-cleaning solutions

• Additive optimization within green FMCG product lines
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Food Technology, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
